result.summary: The intersection features wide crossing distances and faded pavement markings, which increase pedestrian exposure to traffic. Significant pavement degradation and embedded tracks in the foreground present tripping hazards for those crossing.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement and Tracks
hazards.description: Deep cracks and uneven surfaces around embedded tracks create significant trip hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked asphalt and level the surface around the tracks to ensure a smooth walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style high-visibility markings to improve the visibility of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with embedded trolley tracks and overhead traffic signals but lacks any marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the absence of designated crossing infrastructure and the presence of tracks create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a significant trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for all road users, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the intersection and along the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver yielding.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide roadway with embedded trolley tracks and significantly degraded pavement. The absence of clear crosswalk markings and dedicated pedestrian signals, combined with the presence of tracks, creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create significant tripping and slipping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The lack of visible crosswalk markings reduces driver awareness and pedestrian priority at the intersection.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement surfaces increase the risk of falls, especially near the tracks.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and improve driver compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Upgrades
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide safer crossing intervals.

result.summary: This intersection presents a high-risk environment for pedestrians due to the lack of marked crosswalks across a wide, multi-lane roadway featuring trolley tracks. While sidewalks are present, the expansive asphalt area and complex traffic patterns without dedicated pedestrian signals or refuge islands create significant exposure.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no visible painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any refuge islands.

hazards.name: Trolley Track Hazards
hazards.description: Multiple sets of embedded tracks create tripping hazards and uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Embedded in the roadway throughout the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands between travel lanes to reduce exposure time and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
